reference_preprocessing: The LoC master is a STEREOGRAPH: two frames on a printed mount with publisher text down both margins and a caption block. Fed whole it risked importing the card format or its lettering into a plate whose NEVER list forbids text. Cropped to ONE clean frame and resized to 1920x1080 before use; all refs pre-sized so the first sets the aspect ratio.
method_note: Gated against the NEVER list AND an exploratory pass ('is anything in frame that is not specified'), because a NEVER list is confirmatory by construction and cannot catch what nobody listed. The exploratory pass is what caught the caption text on the rejected candidates.
subject: ARCHAEOLOGIST — German scholar in the trench, 1870s. A TYPE, not a portrait.
rejected_why: Rendered caption text FRONT / THREE-QUARTER / PROFILE across the bottom, violating the no-text NEVER. Dress and props were otherwise correct.
never_checked: no background scenery, props or other figures
asserts: three views, same man across all three
dark three-piece wool suit worn in the trench: jacket, waistcoat, white collar
dark leather shoes, dusty but formal in cut
not_asserted: Jacket lapel treatment is INCONSISTENT between views — lapelled in front, closer to a high collarless collar in profile. Below the NEVER list, flagged rather than hidden; re-roll if the hero shot needs lapel continuity.
